title: Pinsa Bread with Italian Spices
description: A delicious Italian-style flatbread infused with nutty flavors from the pinsa. Perfect as a snack or as a base for your favorite toppings.
instructions: Combine yeast, water, and italian seasoning in a bowl. Let it sit for 10 minutes until yeast activates.
Add pinsa, zesty olive oil, and salt to the yeast mixture. Mix well.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rest in a warm place for 1 hour until it doubles in size.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or pizza stone in the oven at 425°F (220°C) for 10 minutes.
Shape the dough into a round or oblong shape and place it on the preheated skillet or pizza stone.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the inside is cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
